Tune here, not in code. quietToWinter: no threat, no ultimatum until the first winter has passed (bridge opening.js). firstSetbackSeasons: the first ruling that slights the lord who asked comes back this many seasons later, as a plea for amends (about 5:00 in, from a first ruling at ~1:00 on a 40 s season). winterAim: the aim the top bar shows until the first winter has passed (text, how), with a seasons-to-winter count.

winterAim.text: Hold the realm whole to the first winter
winterAim.how: Keep every royal town and every great house with you until the snows have come and gone. Rule at court; the realm is quiet until then.
